name: Remote Worker Visa (E33G)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires annual income of at least USD 60,000 (~USD 5,000/month) from a foreign source, plus a personal bank statement showing at least USD 2,000 over the prior 3 months.

Requires an employment contract with a company registered outside Indonesia (or equivalent foreign client relationships). ANY local Indonesian client, employer, or payment breaks the permit -- there is no de minimis exception.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract with a foreign-registered company, or foreign client contracts
Proof of annual income (USD 60,000+) and bank statement (USD 2,000+, 3 months)

sources.title: Emerhub -- E33G Remote Worker Visa: USD 60,000/year income, foreign-employer-only rule, 1-year non-extendable duration

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Indonesia's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: imigrasi.go.id's own E33G page (imigrasi.go.id/wna/daftar-visa-indonesia/E33G) returned an HTTP 403 in this pass, so these figures are tier-3 only. work_rights set 'none' (not 'restricted'): unlike some other countries' remote/digital-nomad visas, this route's own local-work prohibition is absolute -- even a single local client voids it, per the source's own illustrative example (a freelance designer's permit breaks the moment ANY local client, even one, hires them). Non-extendable/non-renewable is a notably strict design choice reproduced here rather than softened -- holders must leave and reapply, or switch to a different permit category, to continue past 1 year. leads_to_pr and leads_to_citizenship left false: this is explicitly a short-term, non-cumulative status with no described settlement pathway.
